text: Mostly to show that they care, I think, and to mark important moments like birthdays or weddings. A gift is a way of saying 'I thought about you' without having to put it into words. But it isn't always completely unselfish. Sometimes people give presents out of obligation, or because they expect something in return, especially in business or in some family situations.

tips.en: Care is the main reason, but it isn't always unselfish adds depth.
tips.kk: Қамқорлық — басты себеп, бірақ it isn't always unselfish тереңдік қосады.
tips.ru: Забота — главное, но it isn't always unselfish добавляет глубину.

title.en: The main reason and a hidden one

tips.example: But it isn't always completely unselfish

tips.en: “I thought about you” without words explains the idea simply.
tips.kk: Сөзсіз «I thought about you» — сыйлықтың мәні қарапайым тілмен.
tips.ru: «I thought about you» без слов — смысл подарка простыми словами.
tips.example: A gift is a way of saying 'I thought about you'

text: It depends on the relationship and the occasion. At weddings in Kazakhstan, giving money in an envelope is completely normal and actually very practical, because the couple can spend it on what they really need. For close friends, though, I prefer a real present, because choosing it shows that you know the person. Money can feel a little impersonal in that situation.

tips.en: Weddings and close friends — two cases with different answers.
tips.kk: Той және жақын достар — екі жағдай, әртүрлі жауап.
tips.ru: Свадьба и близкие друзья — два случая, разные ответы.
tips.example: At weddings in Kazakhstan, giving money in an envelope is completely normal

tips.en: Choosing it shows that you know the person gives a precise reason.
tips.kk: Choosing it shows that you know the person — дәл түрткі.
tips.ru: Choosing it shows that you know the person — точная мотивация.
tips.example: choosing it shows that you know the person

questions.question: Is it better to give money or a present?

text: Some people definitely do, especially around New Year, when there's a lot of pressure to buy something for everyone — colleagues, teachers, distant relatives. Shops and advertising make it worse by creating a sense that a cheap gift means you don't care. As a result, some families end up in debt in January. I think people would be happier agreeing on a budget or doing a secret gift exchange instead.

tips.en: Advertising creates the feeling that a cheap gift means you don't care.
tips.kk: Жарнама арзан сыйлық — немқұрайдылық деген сезім тудырады.
tips.ru: Реклама создаёт ощущение, что дешёвый подарок — это равнодушие.
tips.example: creating a sense that a cheap gift means you don't care

tips.en: A budget or a secret gift exchange is a practical suggestion.
tips.kk: Бюджет не жасырын алмасу — практикалық ұсыныс.
tips.ru: Бюджет или тайный обмен — практичное предложение.
tips.example: agreeing on a budget or doing a secret gift exchange instead

questions.question: Do people spend too much on gifts at holidays?

text: It's made gift-giving much more convenient. You can order something at midnight and have it delivered straight to a friend in another city, which is great when you live far apart. On the downside, it's also made gifts a bit less personal. When everything is chosen from the same few websites in two clicks, the present can feel more like a transaction than a thoughtful gesture.

tips.en: Ordering at midnight for a friend in another city shows the benefit clearly.
tips.kk: Түн ортасында басқа қаладағы досқа тапсырыс — пайда көрнекі.
tips.ru: Заказ в полночь другу в другой город — польза наглядно.
tips.example: have it delivered straight to a friend in another city

tips.en: More like a transaction than a gesture evaluates the downside precisely.
tips.kk: More like a transaction than a gesture — кемшілікке дәл баға.
tips.ru: More like a transaction than a gesture — точная оценка минуса.
tips.example: more like a transaction than a thoughtful gesture

questions.question: How has online shopping changed the way people give gifts?

text: Small gifts can be a nice way of saying thank you, especially at the end of a busy year. For employees, though, I think most people would prefer a bonus or an extra day off to another branded mug. With clients, companies need to be careful, because an expensive gift can look like an attempt to influence a decision. Something modest and useful is usually the safest option.

tips.en: Employees and clients follow different rules.
tips.example: With clients, companies need to be careful

tips.en: Another branded mug is light irony and sounds natural.
tips.kk: Another branded mug — жеңіл әжуа, табиғи естіледі.
tips.ru: Another branded mug — лёгкая ирония, звучит естественно.
